title: Fix Mosh terminal startup failure crashing the daemon
description:
Cohesion review of master at 9f0f7e3 confirmed a preexisting daemon crash through the public Mosh API.

When terminal creation fails, internal/mosh/session.go marks the session ended without initializing its emulator/base screen. The next timer tick calls emu.Snapshot() (around line 173), panicking the daemon. Reproduced using mosh.Dial with ClientConfig{Command: []string{"/definitely/missing/..."}}. Missing executables, invalid work directories and PTY allocation failures can reach this path.

Fix the startup-failure path and represent pending startup, running, failed and completed states explicitly. Keep terminal and screen synchronization ownership coherent, and permit failure/exit reporting without an initialized screen. Ensure a failed session cannot terminate the server or damage unrelated sessions.

Add regression coverage for terminal creation errors, client-visible failure, resource cleanup and continued server availability. Preserve normal final-output and exit behavior. Run relevant race/lifecycle tests and Mosh interoperability checks.
